Overview

Baotou is a city in Inner Mongolia with a population of 2,709,000. A major industrial city in Inner Mongolia, known for its rare earth mining, steel production, and vast grasslands nearby. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
